verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP compatibility, so you build against the existing ClickHouse clients and drivers unchanged rather than an ObsessionDB-specific SDK. CHKit adds typed, agent-drivable schema-as-code commands, but that is a tooling layer, not a language SDK. missing for 10: first-party ObsessionDB-branded SDKs (language libraries or a management-API SDK), SDK reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against them.
